note: The Wormways' missions (world/missions.gd, shown under the compass): they start with the first rain. A step is done when its event happens: burrow_opened, wormways_in, lair_found (Wormways); gather:<item> (GatherField); worm_struck, worm_burned, worm_driven_off (GreatWorm); shaft_opened (the old shaft's stone heaved off). An event that finishes a later step skips ahead.

hint: The ground's moving... something's coming up.

steps.text: Go down one of the worms' burrows
hint: Those holes the worms came out of go somewhere.

steps.text: Find light: glowing spores grow in the dark
hint: It's so dark down here. Something's glowing over there.
Stones in the clay... black flint. That would make an edge.
That tunnel's too big for these worms. What made it?

steps.text: Something huge is listening. Move softly
Worms hate daylight. Heave the stone off the old shaft
hint: There was a stone in a hole up on the lawn, near the Bare Patch...

steps.text: Lure the Great Worm into the light
hint: Make it come for me across the sunlight. Then jump clear.
It dropped something where the light falls.
